{{Quote|I don't take orders from you, only Count Dooku.|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] to Nix Card|<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides">{{TCW|Heroes on Both Sides}}</ref>}}
'''Nix Card''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] who served as a representative of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He plotted with [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] to bomb [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in an effort to halt peace talks between the Galactic Senate and [[Separatist Senate/Legends|Separatist Parliament]] before they started. He was also secretly an agent of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]].

==Biography==
===The Clone Wars===
[[File:CardDodSaam_HoBS.png|thumb|left|250px|Card meets with Senators Gume Saam and Lott Dod]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Senators [[Lott Dod/Legends|Dod]] and [[Gume Saam/Legends|Saam]] met with Card, who was upset that the bill had been unable to pass immediately. Dod cast the blame on Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]], whose interference he did not expect; although Saam suggested that someone be hired to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] her, Senator Dod dismissed the idea as too difficult to accomplish. Dod and Card were in agreement, however, that the business of their respective organizations was violence in this case. The [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] suggested that they bring the war directly to Coruscant to spur the Senate to pass their legislation&mdash;he argued that a thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]] without a direct attack on the capital had given its residents a false sense of safety. Card contacted Count Dooku for assistance in carrying out the plot; Dooku tasked the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] with overseeing the transfer of disguised [[Infiltrator/Demolition droid|demolition droids]] to Coruscant to wreak havoc and force the Senate to act.<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" />

Before the infiltration units could succeed in their mission, Amidala traveled to the Confederate capital of [[Raxus Secundus|Raxus]] and convinced Separatist Senator [[Mina Bonteri/Legends|Mina Bonteri]] to initiate a call for negotiations between the warring governments within the Separatist Congress, a motion supported by a majority of its senators. With the resolution passed, Dooku contacted the three conspirators on Coruscant, who were troubled by the development and wanted to know what had happened to the demolition droids' mission. The Count did not share their concern; he knew that once the droids carried out their programming, the move for peace would be halted and the war would continue. When the time came for the Republic Senate to vote on the peace initiative, the demolition units succeeded in [[Bombing of Coruscant's central power distribution grid/Legends|destroying]] a [[Central power distribution grid/Legends|Coruscanti power generator]], knocking out power to the [[Senate District/Legends|Senate District]] and setting off a series of explosions that injured many of the planet's citizens. Senator Saam used the situation to his advantage, prompting several members of the Senate&mdash;including [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]&mdash;to call for the deregulation of the banks to secure the [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|money]] necessary to finance the increase in troop production. Card briefly attended a Zygerrian Slavery Auction. He also arrested Padmé Amidala for espionage and arrested the [[Core Five]] on charges of corruption.<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides" />

After Amidala's liberation, the [[Core Five/Legends|Core Five]] blamed Card for his failure to prevent her from uncovering information, which proved their corruption had almost caused the bankruptcy of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] but Card defiantly stood his ground saying on record that it was the Core Five who allowed these events to happen. In his private office, Card contacted [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] and informed him that their plan was ready. His benefactor then eased his concerns by assuring him that he would be protected.<ref name="Rise of Clovis">{{TCW|The Rise of Clovis}}</ref>

After the [[Invasion of Scipio/Legends|Battle of Scipio]] which resulted in the death of Clovis, Nix Card ceded control of the banks to the [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Office of the Supreme Chancellor]] thus directly into the hands of Palpatine as the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] had intended from the start.<ref name="Crisis at the Heart">{{TCW|Crisis at the Heart}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Card was voiced by [[Corey Burton]], who also voices Separatist leader [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]].<ref name="Heroes on Both Sides Ep Guide" />
